deadline.value: General deadline January 5, 2027 (Mathematics Ph.D./M.A.); students applying by then are considered for departmental support; space available June 1, 2027.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required and is not considered.
gre_general.quote: The General GRE is not required and will not be considered during the application review process.

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is optional.
gre_subject.quote: The Mathematics Subject GRE is optional.

ielts_min.value: The department requires an overall IELTS band of at least 7.
ielts_min.quote: Overall band score of at least 7 on a 9-point scale

funding.value: Most incoming Ph.D. students receive a five-year funding package; applicants are considered automatically.
funding.quote: Most incoming Ph.D. students receive a five-year funding package

also.quote: All applicants are automatically considered for departmental funding

entry_route.value: Students who enter with a bachelor's degree have five years to finish the Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: Students entering with a B.A. or B.S. should accomplish their Ph.D. by the end of their fifth year.

supervisor.value: No supervisor rule on the fetched pages.

notes: Applied Mathematics Graduate Group (Ph.D./M.S.) on the same page has the same January 5, 2027 deadline and no GRE; it is one field, so no separate record. The department lists an iBT minimum of 80 (note: 80 is the minimum for admission). It is not recorded because it conflicts with the university 4.5 new-scale rule and the page does not state a different rule.
